title: My first #IndieWeb sessions at @edcampct 2015
summary: Scrolling through photos last night I stumbled on what was probably my first #IndieWeb talks I did. Mozilla Clubs are gone, Mozilla Thimble is gone ( come December)... Heck all Mozilla Learning is gone.... IndieWeb still here! Growing every day.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Scrolling through photos last night I stumbled on what was probably my first #IndieWeb talks I did.

Mozilla Clubs are gone, Mozilla Thimble is gone ( come December)... Heck all Mozilla Learning is gone....

IndieWeb still here! Growing every day.
